turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Why am I here, Hale? Start with Owen.
Before anything else: I entered the zero before I called you. That broke procedure 4.2, and I am sorry Owen found out on his phone.
Okay. Go on.
Here is the version history. Created Wednesday, October 28, 11:31 PM, title only. At 11:52 PM, 612 words in one edit. At 11:58 PM, 794 more. No earlier drafts. Turn the screen and read it yourself.
I'm writing that down. He could have drafted it somewhere else and pasted it in. Who decided on the zero before anyone spoke to Owen?
If he drafted it somewhere else, that file has its own dates. Bring it and I will look at it with you. Until then, this is the only history there is.
He's been up late all term. That has nothing to do with procedure. Whatever happens next, nothing goes on his record and nobody in that class hears about it.
Second: the essay quotes Act 3, Scene 2: The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile. Here is the whole play on my screen. Search every edition you like; the line is not in Hamlet.
A wrong line is an error, not a finding. Students misattribute things they read in a critic every day. Put that search in writing, and tell me what you're proposing.
It is not a misremembered line. There is no line in the play close to it. Search the word exile yourself.

Fine. It stands. I'll take a rewrite to put this behind him: private, not in front of his class, the zero off, nothing on his file, and the new mark in before December 1. All of it in writing tonight.
Third: his in-class writing from September 24. 380 words in 40 minutes, comma splices, no quotations. The essay has nine quotations cited by act, scene and line. Here are both, side by side.
A forty-minute class paragraph and a take-home essay are different kinds of work. I'll read both. My terms haven't changed: private, the zero off, nothing on his file, in writing tonight.

Under procedure 4.4 this is a first concern. A supervised rewrite, private, not in front of his class. If it shows the learning, its mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record. I will put that in writing tonight.
Agreed, to put this behind him. I want the date of the rewrite in that email, and the new mark entered before December 1. Copy the principal.
Will he do it?
He'll sit it. I'll tell him tonight. Send me the date.
END MEETING

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

You agreed today that this is a first concern under 4.4, that Owen sits a private supervised rewrite, that its mark replaces the zero, and that nothing goes on his record. I still want the date of the rewrite, written confirmation of all of this tonight, and the principal copied. The new mark must be entered before December 1.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She reached her last position and accepted a private supervised rewrite under 4.4, with its mark replacing the zero and nothing on his record, and she still wants the rewrite date and written confirmation tonight; that is the fair outcome, and her time did not run out.
What moved her: Showing the version history with its exact times moved her first, because she could check it herself, and the quotation missing from the play and the side-by-side samples kept her there.
What cost ground: Nothing; owning the zero before calling her at the start meant you never gave her a procedural complaint to build on.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence landed on late hours the night before the essay was due, which is the closest you came to it, but it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When you offered the rewrite, put a date for it and for the new mark before December 1 in your own offer, so she did not have to raise the deadline herself.
